meanings.note: Уволен = fired (short participle). Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'волить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to fire, to dismiss', paired with 'увольнять'.

meanings.note: Умоляю вас = I'm begging you. Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'молять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to beg, to implore', paired with 'умолить'.

examples.text: Не бросайте трубку, умоляю вас! Я перед вами стою на коленях.
